name: Web Plura Revenue Shield – Checkout, Revenue Leakage & Recovery Risk Monitor
author: Web Plura

sections.description:
Web Plura Revenue Shield helps WooCommerce store owners review local signals that may affect checkout, revenue operations, and recovery follow-up.

Free version

The free WordPress.org plugin runs inside WordPress for WooCommerce stores and does not require a Web Plura account. After local processing consent is accepted, administrators can run revenue-risk scans and review the results in wp-admin. Free local scans remain available after local processing consent.

Included free features:

  • Review failed, pending, and abandoned checkout signals.
  • Spot refund, coupon, payment, shipping, stock, and margin risks.
  • Review local aggregate gateway, category, location, customer-segment, inventory, lead, and recovery insights.
  • Review WooCommerce Recovery Opportunities and record local review status without sending messages.
  • Save local notes, review status, and recovered-value details for recovery opportunities.
  • Export CSV files, print summaries, and create JSON support exports.

The free plugin is WooCommerce-only and self-contained. It does not send recovery messages and does not include Easy Digital Downloads or SureCart source support.

Pro version

Web Plura Revenue Shield Pro is an optional paid Web Plura product/service for stores and teams that want hosted services beyond the local free plugin. Limited examples of Pro service areas may include hosted report history, scheduled monitoring, cloud-backed workflows, additional commerce source coverage, and team-oriented reporting.

Paid hosted services are managed through a Web Plura Revenue Shield product subscription with product-scoped tiers: Free, Lite, Starter, Growth, Pro, Team, Business, Agency, and Enterprise.

Features may change over time; see the official Web Plura product page for the latest feature list.

Terms: https://wplura.com/terms
Privacy: https://wplura.com/privacy
Product page: https://wplura.com/products/web-plura-revenue-shield

External Services

The free WordPress.org plugin does not connect to external services. WooCommerce scans, reports, exports, local notes, and Recovery Opportunity review run inside WordPress.

Optional hosted Web Plura Revenue Shield Pro services are separate from the free plugin’s local operation and are described only as optional services on the official Web Plura product page.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from the WordPress.org plugin directory, or upload the web-plura-revenue-shield folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active if you want revenue-risk scans.
  3. Activate Revenue Shield from the Plugins screen.
  4. Open Revenue Shield in wp-admin.
  5. Review and accept processing consent.
  6. Run the first revenue-risk scan.
sections.faq:
Does Revenue Shield require setup before scans?

No. WooCommerce scans, the basic score, evidence review, opportunity review, and exports are available after consent is accepted.

Does it work without WooCommerce?

The plugin is built for WooCommerce. If WooCommerce is not active, the plugin shows dependency guidance instead of running scans.

Does the plugin send recovery messages?

No. The plugin shows recovery opportunities and lets administrators save local review notes/status only. It does not contact customers or send recovery messages.

What stays in WordPress?

Scan evidence, opportunity review, local review status, internal notes, and export tools stay in WordPress.

Does the plugin promise revenue recovery?

No. The plugin identifies operational signals and review candidates. Actual outcomes depend on store configuration, available data, customer behavior, payment provider behavior, and administrator follow-up.
